stateKeys.name: autoRenew
stateKeys.type: boolean — false once the owner cancels; a cancelled plan is never charged again

stateKeys.name: attempts
stateKeys.type: number — dunning retry counter 0..3; non-zero only while status is 'grace'

dataFields.cardOnFile: boolean — a payment card is on file when the trial clock elapses

dataFields.newCard: boolean — a new payment card was provided

specialRules.name: cancelled-trial-never-converts
specialRules.note: A cancelled trial (autoRenew=false) must reject CONVERT regardless of cardOnFile — a plan is never charged while cancelled. This rejection applies ONLY when autoRenew=false; an active trial (autoRenew=true) with cardOnFile=true transitions to paid.

specialRules.name: no-card-no-conversion
specialRules.note: CONVERT with cardOnFile=false is a rejected no-op even for an active trial — the first-period charge requires a card on file. This rejection applies ONLY when cardOnFile=false.

specialRules.name: duplicate-convert-rejected
specialRules.note: CONVERT redelivered to an already-paid plan (webhook retry/redelivery) is always a rejected no-op — the plan is never charged twice for the first period. CONVERT from grace or lapsed is likewise a rejected no-op (reason 'convert-only-from-trial').

specialRules.name: stale-charge-webhook-in-trial
specialRules.note: Charge webhooks arriving while status is trial are stale and always rejected — no renewal charge exists before conversion.

specialRules.name: stale-charge-webhook-in-lapsed
specialRules.note: Charge webhooks arriving on a lapsed plan are stale and always rejected.

specialRules.name: attempts-capped-at-three
specialRules.note: In grace, CHARGE_FAILED increments attempts by 1 up to a maximum of 3 (BEHAVIORAL branch); a further CHARGE_FAILED when attempts is already 3 is a rejected no-op. This rejection applies ONLY when attempts >= 3.

specialRules.name: lapse-requires-exhausted-dunning
specialRules.note: LAPSE is accepted ONLY in grace with attempts >= 3 (moves to lapsed and resets attempts to 0 — attempts is non-zero only in grace); in grace with attempts < 3, and in every other status, LAPSE is a rejected no-op.

specialRules.name: reactivate-requires-new-card
specialRules.note: REACTIVATE with newCard=false is a rejected no-op; with newCard=true a lapsed plan returns to paid with attempts=0 and autoRenew=true. From any status other than lapsed REACTIVATE is always rejected (reason 'reactivate-only-from-lapsed').

specialRules.name: cancel-is-idempotent
specialRules.note: CANCEL when autoRenew is already false is a rejected no-op (idempotent, harmless); otherwise it sets autoRenew=false in ANY status and never changes status or attempts — a paid plan stays paid until period end, a trial simply never converts.

noOpRule: An action that does not apply in the current state yields post == pre (an observable reject(reason), never a throw). No terminal states are declared: lapsed is re-activatable and a cancelled trial is an absorbing configuration under status 'trial', so no primary-state value uniquely ends every scenario.
